title: ToolCatalog
description: v1 — the closed set of tools the airlock executes on the agent's behalf. Single source of truth used three ways: (a) Anthropic tool input_schema the oracle gives the model, (b) validation the airlock applies to every ToolCall, (c) the contract. The airlock executes NOTHING outside this set.

tools.description: The closed tool set, for discovery.

fetch_series_args.description: Fetch a series from its source API. seriesId is a closed enum → there is no argument that expresses an arbitrary host.

vintage.description: Which vintage to request where the source supports it. Defaults to latest.

read_prior_vintage_args.description: Read the last dataset the daemon stored for this series/month, for revision detection.

store_dataset_args.description: Draft dataset the agent assembles. The airlock adds source (from CLI), datasetId, asOf and provenance (it did the fetch) — the agent cannot forge those — then validates the full IndicatorDataset.

finish_args.description: End the tool loop. abstain = data not ready this wake; nothing is stored or broadcast.
